annotations.title: Image size for a streaming platform

description: Exact recommended pixel size, aspect ratio, file limits, formats and design tips for streamer images: Twitch emotes, badges, panels, banners, offline screen, profile picture and overlay; YouTube banner, thumbnail and profile picture; Discord emoji, sticker, banner, server icon and avatar; Kick banner; TikTok profile picture; X header. Specs were checked against each platform in October 2026. Pass "asset" for one answer, or only "platform" to list every size for that platform.

asset.description: The image, e.g. "twitch emote", "youtube thumbnail", "discord sticker", "kick banner".

platform.description: Optional platform filter. With no "asset", lists all sizes for it.
